artifacts.summary: Five-phase emitter-side collapse of per-path scope-excursion rows into one record per drop event via a new shared batched-record library, with multi-path regression coverage at both emitters, a repo-wide single-emitter guard, and a doc disposition for the three-site parity claim.

memory_candidates.content: validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification measurement extracts EVERY test-*.sh token anywhere in a phase's justification block as a claimed suite name, and requires the claim to name the selector's entire output for that phase's harvested paths -- not a representative subset. Two consequences for plan authoring: (1) never write the covering check in fully-qualified form (verify-touched.sh followed by the phase's declared paths) when any declared path is a tests/test-*.sh file, because that path is parsed as a fabricated suite claim; name the command alone and enumerate the suite list separately. (2) A phase whose touched set includes a broad registry file (manifest.json, index-entries.json) maps to dozens of suites, making an enumerated list unwritable -- declare such a phase at the full tier with a cross-cutting-surface justification instead, which carries no suite tokens and is skipped by the measurement entirely.
